summary: The Instacart site is a setting, not a constant: GraphQL endpoint, Origin/Referer and cookie-domain filtering all follow one active host resolved from $INSTACART_HOST, then config.json "host" (instacart config set-host), then www.instacart.com, and only instacart.<tld> hosts are accepted.
reason: Regional storefronts such as www.instacart.ca use the same web GraphQL API on their own origin with their own session cookies; a hardcoded www.instacart.com sends .ca cookies to the wrong origin and auth login ignores .ca cookies. The domain allowlist keeps session cookies from being sent to a non-Instacart host.
